title: feat(ci): publish a reusable GitHub workflow for consumers
problem: Consumers must copy workflow YAML; there is no supported reusable workflow.
why: A reusable workflow lowers adoption friction and centralizes best practices.
scope: Add `.github/workflows/reusable-scan.yml` with `workflow_call` inputs mirroring the action.
guidance: Document usage and required permissions in `docs/github-integration.md`.
acceptance: Reusable workflow documented and internally tested on this repo
tests: Use it from the repository's own security workflow
security: Default to least privilege; never require secrets.

title: feat(github): update a single PR comment instead of posting new ones
problem: If the opt-in comment is enabled, each push adds a new comment, which is noisy.
why: Editing a single sticky comment keeps PRs clean and is the expected behavior.
scope: Find a prior comment by a marker and update it; create only if absent.
guidance: Use `gh api` to list and edit comments; key on a hidden HTML marker.
acceptance: Only one scanner comment exists per PR
tests: Manual verification documented; logic kept simple
security: Never post for fork PRs; never include secrets.
dod: Merged and verified on a test PR.

title: feat(github): create a check run with inline annotations
problem: Annotations rely on `::error` workflow commands, which have limited structure and no severity levels.
why: The Checks API provides richer, structured annotations and a clear pass/fail conclusion.
scope: Add an optional step/action that creates a check run with annotations from JSON output.
guidance: Use `gh api` or a small script; cap annotation count per the GitHub limit.
acceptance: Check run created with correct conclusions
security: Fork PRs cannot create checks with write tokens; guard accordingly.

title: feat(ci): scheduled baseline refresh workflow
problem: Baselines must be refreshed manually, which is easy to forget.
why: A scheduled refresh (opened as a PR for review) keeps baselines current without weakening review.
scope: Add a scheduled workflow that regenerates the baseline and opens a pull request.
guidance: Use `peter-evans/create-pull-request` or `gh` to open a PR; never push to main directly.
security: Never auto-merge; baseline changes require review.

title: test(ci): matrix across supported Soroban SDK versions
problem: Detector behavior against different `soroban-sdk` versions is not verified.
why: API drift between SDK versions can change what patterns are valid.
scope: Add fixtures pinned to two or three SDK versions and run them in a CI matrix.
guidance: Update the compatibility matrix doc with results.

title: docs(github): document and verify private-repository SARIF requirements
problem: GitHub code scanning requires different configuration on private repositories, which is not documented.
why: Users on private repos otherwise hit confusing upload failures.
scope: Document required settings and add a troubleshooting entry.
